from . import ConflictError is inline as a circular-import workaround; fragile and executed on the conflict hot path, though not a correctness bug

conflict check (_last_committed read) and append (_write) are not atomic and no lock is held; two concurrent appends for the same uncommitted key can both pass the None check and both write, violating FR-4's MUST raise ConflictError / MUST NOT append
